summary: I played the session's changes in the sandbox (firefly glow at noon, evening clouds, watering with the tipped can) with FakeInteraction and looked at the screenshots. The three new tests pass. The glow, the tipped can and the dry-patch idea work in the data, but on screen the can is not visible, the fireflies look like big flat discs, and the clouds could not be judged. The four host failures from the first report stand.

failures.what: While Sprout waters, the green can cannot be seen at all
failures.steps: At 11:00 let Sprout water (garden tend goal) and take a screenshot from the follow camera (s56-pour).
failures.expected: The tipped can shows in Sprout's hand with the stream coming out (the #309 claim).
failures.actual: The can's tilt is set (the test passes), but the picture shows only Sprout with drops. The follow camera sits where the can is hidden behind Sprout, and Marshmallow stands in the patch beside it. The author already noted this as unverified.

failures.what: Firefly glow reads as huge flat yellow discs with a hard ring, not a soft halo
failures.steps: At 11:00 start Firefly catch, hold W 0.4 s, take a screenshot (s56-firefly-glow).
failures.expected: Small warm lights with a faint fading halo.
failures.actual: Two flies near the cottage show as big opaque yellow discs. One has a visible outer ring and covers part of the cottage. They hide the thing Sprout is walking towards.

failures.what: Evening cloud rims could not be judged: the follow camera looks at the ground under trees at 19:24
failures.steps: Jump to 19:24 and take a screenshot (s56-clouds-evening).
failures.expected: A view where the sky and cloud edges show.
failures.actual: No sky in the picture at all. Only the data was checked (3 rim shells per puff, alpha in 0.02 to 0.2, up in the sky).

failures.what: Berry race: critters do not give Sprout a head start (host failure)
failures.steps: Start Berry race; at 0.5 s read the rivals' goals.

failures.what: Flower gift: giver says only 'Sprout! Look what I found!' (host failure)
failures.expected: The giver says a gift line to the friend and the friend answers with hearts.
failures.actual: Wibbles' speech is only 'Sprout! Look what I found!'.

failures.what: Presents: Sprout never reaches Pickles (host failure)
failures.actual: Sprout stays 12.5 m away, action sleep/walk.

failures.what: Follow camera view is blocked (host failure)
failures.steps: Run the follow camera clear-view test, subject 10.
failures.expected: Obstruction close to the goal view's 0.44.
failures.actual: Obstruction 0.62. Probably the s56 follow-camera changes.

tests_added: S56 Firefly catch at noon: every fly has its glow shells on it and they move with it
S56 Evening clouds have faint rim shells that follow the puffs
S56 Watering: the can tips towards the rows while pouring and goes home after; workshop is not at the gate
